title: Daily Recap — Thursday Oct 22, 2026
html:
Links: SPY · Watchlist · Options Playbook · Fed Tracker · Federal Reserve Claude Doc: Note: this is the post-close version. An earlier file for this date already exists and was left unchanged.

1. Bottom line

SPY fell 1.18% to $763.96 and closed below its 20-day ($770.72) and 50-day ($767.22) averages. It held the Oct 16 low ($760.64) and the 23.6% Fib of the Apr–Oct swing ($763.49). A scare about how AI spending gets paid for sank chips: the semiconductor index fell 6.7%, with all 30 members down. Nvidia's CEO said cloud start-ups are short of working capital, Lam Research flagged supply limits, and Meta fell 7% on about $825B in commitments. Under the surface, equal-weight S&P rose 0.73%, the Dow was flat, and staples, utilities and health care led. Oil jumped (WTI $99.47) as bonds rallied (10-yr yield −17 bp to 4.96%).

Earnings: LMT +7.0%, a beat and raise with a record $292B backlog. TSLA −3.1%, a beat on adjusted EPS but a capex cut. SPCX −9.1%, giving back its post-earnings pop. BE −8.7%, then about −6% after hours despite a beat.
